headline: Alpha Minespine
title: Alpha Minespine | Dodge The Seismic Wave | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Alpha Minespine waits in Beast Fang Ridge, and it is an Earth boss. Bring Water or Grass Aniimo to hit it for extra damage. Its big move is a tail hammer that sends a seismic wave across the arena, so dodge it or get to higher ground instead of taking the hit. Then strike back between waves. Which element will you bring? Comment below!
description: Alpha Minespine is an Earth boss in Beast Fang Ridge. Water and Grass hit it hard, and you should dodge its seismic waves.
joke: Do not stand still, this boss really knows how to shake things up.
